g.title: wc3_request_security
g.text: Three layers before any view executes

g.title: cluster_demo
g.text: DEMO_READ_ONLY=True → blocks ALL writes, no exemptions

g.title: cluster_writegate
g.text: WRITE_GATE_ENABLED=True → allow-listed paths only for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE

g.title: cluster_json
g.text: API_JSON_DEFAULT=True → all responses are JSON unless path is HTML-exempt
